class.name: EffectData
class.brief_description: A data resource that defines a gameplay effect, including stat modifiers, durations, and tag alterations.
class.description: [EffectData] is a configuration resource used to define buffs, debuffs, or instant changes (like healing or damage) applied to a target. It allows you to modify attributes using [ModifierData] and manipulate a character's gameplay tags for a specified duration type.

members.member: The active lifetime of the effect in seconds. This is only used if [code]effect_type[/code] is set to [constant Temporary].
Determines how the effect's lifetime is treated (Ex: whether it is instant/permanent, lasts for a countdown, or persists until manually removed).
A list of attribute modifiers (like "+10 Strength" or "-15% Movement Speed") applied to the target by this effect.
The unique identifier for this effect, useful for debugging, UI displays, or searching for active effects on an entity.

A collection of gameplay tags granted to the target while this effect is active (Ex: adding a [code]Stunned[/code] or [code]Poisoned[/code] tag). These are removed automatically when the effect is removed.

A collection of gameplay tags stripped from the target when this effect is applied (e.g., removing a [code]Stealth[/code] tag upon taking damage). These are added back automatically when the effect is removed.

constants.constant: The effect applies instantly and its changes are baked permanently into the base attributes. It does not look at [code]duration[/code] and cannot be naturally reverted.

The effect behaves like a traditional buff or debuff. Its changes persist only for the amount of seconds specified in [code]duration[/code], after which it is automatically removed and its changes are reverted.
The effect stays active indefinitely until explicitly removed by a gameplay mechanic, script, or ability (Ex: a toggled stance or a curse that requires a specific cure).
